title: Success Through A Positive Mental Attitude

questions.q: What does Hill call the number one determining factor of success?
a: A habitually positive mental attitude
A willingness to work longer hours
Access to influential mentors
Natural talent in your chosen field
questions.why: Lesson 1 says how much you accomplish tracks how well you nurture your positive mental attitude.

questions.q: What did Henry Ford insist on building despite his engineers' doubts?
a: A cheap, mass-produced V8 engine
A car that ran entirely on electricity
A factory that needed no supervisors
A luxury model aimed at wealthy buyers
questions.why: Lesson 1 says Ford persisted for a year until the first mass-produced V8 engine existed.

a: Solving problems
Avoiding failure
Winning public recognition
Learning from books
questions.why: Lesson 2 says every great achievement began with someone finding a solution to a problem.

questions.q: What did Charlie Ward's shift in attitude eventually lead to?
a: A job offer that made him a millionaire
An early release from prison
A career as a prison guard
A book written about his life
questions.why: Lesson 2 says Ward impressed Herbert Bigelow, took over his company after he died and became rich.

questions.q: How does Hill suggest putting autosuggestion to work?
a: Write your desired future in a sentence and repeat it twice daily
Meditate on your goals for an hour each morning
Tell a friend your goals so they hold you accountable
Review your goals only once you have reached them
questions.why: Lesson 3 describes writing a one-sentence picture of life a year from now and repeating it daily.
